get.description: Public keys (all keys in the ring, incl. retired ones whose tokens may still be live) for other services.

post.description:
Single intake for self-signup (anonymous, per-IP rate limited) and marketing-service (X-Service-Key with the
`onboarding.submit` scope) and staff (Bearer with onboarding.manage). Same state machine for all.

get.description:
Staff (onboarding.read) or a service with scope `onboarding.read`. Services only see marketing-sourced
applications (their own intake channel); anything else is a 404 and the submitter IP is never exposed to them.

post.description: Runs (or retries, from `failed`) provisioning. The pos-service call-out is a stub interface.

put.description: Replaces the plan's feature set. Entitlements of every tenant on this plan change, and each diff is recorded.

get.description:
Entitlement check for other services. Auth: Bearer staff token or X-Service-Key with `entitlements.read`.
`ref` is a tenant id or slug. Unknown tenant -> 404 (callers must fail closed).

Contract for pos-service (docs/entitlements-contract.md). Auth: X-Service-Key with scope `entitlements:read`
(or staff with entitlements.read). Unknown tenant -> 404; callers must fail closed.

post.description:
A time-boxed, audited authorization for ONE support engineer to look at ONE tenant. This service only records it and
can mint a short-lived token for pos-service to verify; it never fetches or proxies tenant operational data.

get.description: For pos-service: is this grant still valid right now (catches revocation before token expiry)?

post.description: Append-only; idempotent per (reporting service, external_id). Service clients only.

put.description: Non-secret, platform-wide settings (feature switches, maintenance banner, limits). Secrets do not belong here.
